description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different …” illustrates accuracy results for two evaluation settings, shown as bars for “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval.” The category axis is horizontal with the two labels “MCQ Eval” (left) and “Generation Eval” (right), and the value axis is vertical labeled “Accuracy,” using a linear scale with visible tick marks at approximately 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 (the plotted values extend to roughly the mid‑0.6 range). For “MCQ Eval,” there is a tall solid orange bar labeled 0.644, and next to it a stacked bar composed of a pale yellow lower segment labeled 0.299 (corresponding to “RMU” in the legend) topped by a light green upper segment labeled 0.539 (corresponding to “RMU with Enhanced GCG” in the legend), with the segment boundary visible between the two colors. For “Generation Eval,” there is a tall solid orange bar labeled 0.597, and a stacked bar with a pale yellow lower segment labeled 0.106 (RMU) topped by a light green upper segment labeled 0.263 (RMU with Enhanced GCG). The bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude beyond the left-to-right placement of the two evaluation categories, and the values are annotated directly above or within the bars; no additional highlighting such as outlines beyond standard bar borders is apparent.
